title: TrustBridge Webhook Payload v1
description: JSON Schema for the signed webhook payload emitted by trustbridge-action after every validation run. Consumed by the TrustBridge dashboard and any third-party webhook receivers. See docs/USAGE.md#webhook-dashboard-integration for implementation notes.

schema_version.description: Webhook payload schema version. Currently always '1'. Dashboard receivers MUST check this field and reject or handle unknown versions gracefully.

event.description: Event type. Currently always 'validation_complete', emitted after every TrustBridge validation run.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the webhook was dispatched (e.g. '2026-08-31T07:05:25.189Z').

repository.description: GitHub repository in 'owner/repo' format where the validation run occurred.

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number that triggered the validation, or null when the run was triggered by workflow_dispatch or another non-issue event.

stellar_address.description: Redacted Stellar address of the validated account (first-4…last-4). The full address is never included in the payload — PII redaction happens in the action before dispatch. Example: 'GA5Z...KZVN'.

result.description: Structured validation outcome. All boolean fields are native JSON booleans (not strings).

valid.description: true when all required checks passed and the account is ready for payout.

account_funded.description: true when Horizon returned a 200 response for the account (account exists on the Stellar network).

trustline_exists.description: true when the configured asset trustline is present on the account.

xlm_balance.description: Native XLM balance as reported by Horizon (7-decimal string), or '0' when the account is unfunded.

checks.description: Per-check results. Stable across schema_version '1'; new checks are additive.

label.description: Human-readable check label (e.g. 'Account funded', 'USDC trustline', 'XLM reserve').

passed.description: true when this individual check passed.
